newsitem.title: USA: Delia's files with SEC for 2 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Delia's files with SEC for 2 mln shr offer.

text.p: Delia's Inc filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register up to two million common shares, of which the company will sell half and current shareholders including company directors will offer the other half.
The New York-based direct marketer of casual apparel for girls said proceeds from the shares it sells, an estimated $20.7 million, will be used for working capital and general corporate needs.
Underwriters for the offering are Hambrecht & Quist, Oppenheimer & Co Inc and Montgomery Securities. They have an over-allotment option of up to 300,000 shares.
After the offering, the company said it will have 13,002,977 shares outstanding.
